description: On the tabletop there’s a small open cardboard box near the back, a blue toy block in the middle, a white plastic piece off to the left, and a red plastic fork lying near the front. The right hand reaches in from the right, nudges the red fork, then grasps the blue block, slides it closer, and releases it; the left hand reaches forward to pick up the white plastic piece and carries it off, after which the right hand picks up the red fork and tosses it into the open cardboard box.
